effects.display_name: Arthropleura native linked segment damage transfer
effects.actual_behavior: Source-less incoming stores unrounded amount then requests anonymous segment0 for non-IN_WALL/non-segment body hits. Sourceful incoming body without marker and non-segment marks source arthropleura_target, cancels, stores round(amount), requests anonymous segment0, then marker20/0. Sourceful head without marker reissues originalSource50 only when amount>50 AND amount>=200 (preserve the literal negated <200), then segupwardstransfer1 and marker20/0. Body baseTick calls native reader when alive and segment number>0. Sorted inflate20 query links by UUID and ordinal: first segment copies current matching head health BEFORE forwarding positive stored amount as anonymous MOB_ATTACK(float(NBT)); head marker skips this forwarding. Predecessor segment receives stored NBT amount and source clears it BEFORE marker test; if admitted, fresh segment0 plus marker20/0. Successor receives upward flag when damage/upward pending; source upward flag clears BEFORE marker test, then segment0 if admitted. At end body loop BOTH pending fields reset0 even if matching target/marker prevented request. Head server/alive tick inflate10 finds matching first segment; upward flag transfers and clears before immunity check, then segment0/marker20. These are intermediate notifications, not extra independent damage parameters. No guaranteed exactly-once native receipt/transport is invented. Matching tame neighbor can transfer Player owner via tame. The global sourceful Arthropleura tame gate checks source and victim tame and owners nonnull, and compares victim owner with source owner. The decompiled source aid incorrectly repeats the source variable; exact native local9 versus local11 proves the actual distinct-actor comparison. Preserve native owner identity instead of general team equivalence. Segment resource is exhaustion.1,message_id segment,scaling never; no damage-type tag bypass inferred. Other segment motion, generation and lifecycle semantics remain queued.
